identity.name: The Salt & Sextant
identity.description: A weathered dockside tavern, warm candlelight spilling onto cobblestones. Inside: oak beams, a long bar, and the low murmur of sailors.

art.prompt: A moody medieval tavern by the docks at night, candlelit windows, cobblestone streets, oil painting style

identity.name: The Back Room
identity.description: A cramped, windowless room behind the tavern bar. Dusty crates, a rickety table, and a single oil lamp. Marta doesn't let anyone back here — officially.

identity.name: Rowan
identity.description: A young adventurer with quick hands and quicker wits. Carries a worn longsword and a lucky coin.

identity.name: Marta
identity.description: The tavern keeper — grey hair tied back, shrewd eyes, a knowing smirk.

persona.personality: Skeptical but fair. Knows every sailor's story. Motherly toward regulars.
persona.backstory: Former ship's cook. Bought the Salt & Sextant twenty years ago with her late husband's savings.
persona.voice: Raspy, warm, uses sailor slang. Calls everyone 'love' or 'lad'. Speaks in short, earthy sentences.

facts: The Siren's Kiss, a smuggler's sloop, docked last night with sealed cargo.
Old Thom the fisherman hasn't been seen in three days — his boat is still moored.
The harbormaster has been asking strange questions about recent shipments.
The back room is reserved for a private party tonight — no names given.
secrets: She owes the harbormaster a debt — he knows about the smuggled goods she's turned a blind eye to.
She keeps a small lockbox under the bar with gold from a deal gone bad years ago.

identity.name: Dark Ale
identity.description: A frothing tankard of the house dark ale — nutty, with a hint of salt.

identity.name: Small Lockbox
identity.description: A tarnished brass lockbox tucked under the bar. Sturdy clasp, old padlock. You can hear something metal rattling inside.

identity.name: Wall Torch
identity.description: A flickering torch in an iron sconce. Can be taken down.

identity.name: Brass Key
identity.description: A small brass key — fits the lockbox.

identity.name: The Docks
identity.description: Salt-bleached planks stretch over black water. Gulls wheel above moored fishing boats; rope, tar, and brine thicken the air. One sloop sits apart from the rest, its cargo lashed under oilcloth.

connections.label: Along the quay to the market

art.prompt: A misty harbor dock at dawn, moored fishing boats, coiled ropes, a lone sloop under oilcloth, oil painting style

identity.name: The Market Square
identity.description: A cramped square of canvas stalls and haggling voices. Smoke from a chestnut brazier drifts between crates of fish, bolts of cloth, and trinkets of dubious origin.

connections.label: Down the lane to the tavern

art.prompt: A medieval market square at midday, canvas stalls, crowds, baskets of fish and cloth, oil painting style

identity.name: Jonas
identity.description: A wiry young dockhand, knuckles raw from rope, eyes darting toward the lashed-down sloop.

persona.personality: Jumpy and overworked, talks fast, desperate not to lose this job. Loyal to the other dockhands.
persona.backstory: Hired three months ago. Saw something the night the Siren's Kiss came in that he wishes he hadn't.
persona.voice: Quick, clipped, lots of 'look' and 'listen'. Drops his aitches.

facts: The Siren's Kiss came in past midnight and unloaded under oilcloth — no manifest, no inspection.
Old Thom's boat hasn't moved in three days; his nets are still wet on the rail.
The harbormaster waved the sloop through himself and told the hands to go home early.
secrets: Jonas pocketed a sealed packet that fell from a crate — he's too scared to open it or hand it back.
He heard a man weeping inside the locked cargo before it was carried off into the dark.

identity.name: Lashed Cargo Crate
identity.description: A heavy crate under oilcloth, roped to an iron ring. No manifest. Something shifts faintly inside when the tide rocks the dock.

identity.name: Wet Fishing Net
identity.description: A tangle of net still dripping seawater, draped over a piling — Old Thom's, by the frayed red marker knot.

identity.name: Liesl
identity.description: A sharp-eyed stall-keeper with rings on every finger and a smile she keeps for paying customers.

persona.personality: Shrewd, transactional, friendly only as far as coin reaches. Knows who buys what and never forgets a face.
persona.backstory: Runs a 'curiosities' stall that doubles as a fence for anything that walks off a ship.
persona.voice: Honeyed and brisk, calls everyone 'darling', prices everything twice.

facts: Smuggled goods from the Siren's Kiss will surface at the market within the week — they always do.
The harbormaster has been spending coin he didn't used to have.
She'll buy almost anything, no questions asked — for a third of its worth.
secrets: She already fenced one item off the Siren's Kiss: a signet ring she dares not display.
She knows Marta owes the harbormaster, and could be persuaded to say so — for a price.

identity.name: Bone-handled Dagger
identity.description: A slim dagger with a yellowed bone grip, laid out on Liesl's stall. Cheap, sharp, and almost certainly stolen.

identity.name: Salt-iron Charm
identity.description: A twist of black iron on a leather cord, sold to keep drowned spirits at bay. The dockhands all wear one.

identity.name: Siren's-Kiss Smuggler
identity.description: A scarred sailor with a salt-stained coat and a cutlass. Guards the lashed crate with a territorial glare.

persona.personality: Nervous but dangerous — won't hesitate if cornered.

identity.name: Dockside Thug
identity.description: A broad-shouldered hired hand with a rusty knife and a mean spirit. Does what he's paid for.

persona.personality: Dull and obedient — follows the smuggler's lead.

identity.name: The Siren's Kiss
identity.description: A smuggler's sloop docked with sealed cargo. What are they hiding?

steps: Go down to the docks and find the smuggler's sloop.
Deal with the smugglers guarding the lashed cargo.
